Montréal Communiqué 


Vv 


March 3rd, 1971. 


For release at will 


The Montreal YMCA campaign for $400,000 officially 
gets underway Monday, March 8th. 

Funds will help underwrite dozens of projects affect- 
ing thousands of persons of all ages in Greater Montreal. 
A number of undertakings initiated by the Y in 
Montreal have already emerged as prototypes for people- 

serving associations across the nation. 

Programs now include both long-range efforts to find 
lasting answers to emerging problems and activities to 
meet the growing volume of day-to-day emergencies. 

At the same time, new ways are being developed to 
help boys and girls cope with and enjoy their formative 
years. 

-30- 
For further information please contact: 


Bill Sher 
849-5331.
